Definition
[Volume form on an oriented manifold]

Source: petersen:page-0026, petersen:page-0027 ↗ prop:pet-ch1-signed-volume-basis-independent

On an oriented Riemannian $n$-manifold, the volume form is \[ (\operatorname {vol}_g)_p(v_1,\ldots ,v_n)=\det [g_p(v_i,e_j)], \] where $e_1,\ldots ,e_n$ is any positively oriented orthonormal basis of $T_pM$. It is also denoted $d\, \operatorname {vol}$, without asserting that it is exact.
